messages:
Sofia: We need a concrete rollout + kill/fallback strategy for fallback-manager v2. Customers want safer multi-variant fallbacks and per-tenant routing. I sketched a plan below. @Raj please confirm infra constraints, @Ben add gating metrics.

Raj: Quick Q — does the runtime expose per-tenant routing keys today? Short answer: yes, but it needs a small config API change and a routing-table migration. Prefer canary by account then by region. Also: we need a fast kill-switch and graceful KV TTL handling.

Ben: Agree on account-first canary. Minimum guard metrics: p50/p95 latency, token cost delta, error rate, fallback-rate (how often v2 falls back to older variants), and customer-visible errors. Thresholds I propose: p95 <= 1.2x baseline, error delta < 0.5% absolute, fallback-rate < 0.5% absolute. Alert on breaches.

Kumail: Cohort sizing suggestion: internal -> invited beta (20% of those accounts) for 1 week -> 5% public traffic in us-west for 48h -> regional ramps (us-east, eu, apac) 25% -> 50% -> 100%. If any slice breaches thresholds, cut that slice to 5% or roll back entirely.

Sasha: CS request: emit per-customer "fallback_count" metric and a daily digest for beta customers. If any customer sees >5 fallbacks/hour, page SRE and CS. Provide opt-out for beta.

Sofia: Proposed rollout slices and simple ops config:

```yaml
feature_flags:
  fallback_manager_v2: true
rollout:
  - slice: internal_canary
    pct: 0.01
  - slice: beta_accounts
    pct: 0.20
  - slice: public_us_west
    pct: 0.05
  - slice: regional_ramp
    regions: [us-east, eu, apac]
    ramp_stages: [0.25, 0.5, 1.0]
```

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Feature flag `fallback_manager_v2` created. Safe rollback: `flag set fallback_manager_v2 false` or set slice pct to 0.

Raj: Preflight technical blockers to resolve before >5% traffic: KV cache migration (cold-start spike) — add a cache-warm job and monitor hit-rate; ensure TTLs don't evict active prefixes. Also need explicit mapping v2->v1 for model fallback to avoid tokenizer/format mismatches.

Ben: Instrumentation notes: tag traces with `fallback_v2_cohort`, export cohort-level metrics, add per-slice dashboards (latency, cost, fallback-rate, token usage). Console should expose a one-click rollback that flips flag + reverts routing atomically.

Kumail: I can run the smoke tests and validate the cache warm job. Ready to start internal canary tomorrow EOD if preflights pass. Who owns the smoke checklist?

Sofia: Go/No-go checklist (all required):
- smoke tests pass (no runtime exceptions)
- p95, p50 within thresholds vs baseline
- canary fallback-rate under threshold
- cache-warm job completes, KV hit-rate >= 90%
- rollback runbook tested (1-click + verification)
- customer comms + beta opt-out ready

Sasha: I'll draft customer comms and opt-out today. Also adding escalation steps for CS. Will notify beta cohort.

Raj: Automation: implement an automatic decrease policy: if p95 > 1.2x baseline for 10m OR error rate increases >0.5% for 5m, automatically reduce affected slice by 50% and notify #eng-oncall. Add a circuit-breaker that routes to `fallback_model_v1` if fallback-rate spikes.

Ben: Post-launch analysis: run A/B after 7 days for engagement and cost. Rollback triggers: engagement drop >5% or cost per successful call increase >10%.

Sofia: OK. I'll schedule timeline, assign owners, and add entries to the launch checklist. Plan: internal canary Mon EOD if preflight green. Thanks everyone.
